In an open painted loggia with marble columns, two small cherubs float and hold up a large modern wall calendar at the centre of the picture. The calendar has one page, completely blank, bright plain white, large in the frame and facing the viewer perfectly straight on, with a simple metal binding at the top. Below, robed scholars seen from behind look up at it. The top 35% of the picture is empty soft painted sky with light clouds. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

caption_draft:
5 coding challenges for December.

Advent of Code — https://adventofcode.com/about — Daily puzzles from 1 December
Advent of Cyber — https://tryhackme.com/adventofcyber26 — 24 free security challenges
AdventJS — https://adventjs.dev/ — A new challenge each day
LeetCode Daily Challenge — https://leetcode.com/discuss/post/655704/ — Solve all, earn December's badge
Kaggle Santa 2026 — https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/santa-2026 — Kaggle's yearly holiday competition

Save this for 1 December. Send it to the friend you want to race.

#adventofcode #codingchallenge #leetcode #kaggle #cybersecurity #javascript #firstyear #notyourcollege
